whoItsFor: Developers and people who use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and similar) and want complex answers as a readable one-page HTML instead of a wall of text.
useCases: Explain a concept such as the TCP three-way handshake with sequence and state diagrams
Map out how the modules in a repository fit together, with a folder tree and call graph
Compare options such as Redis vs Memcached in a table with a verdict
